opportunities.title: Cisco's CVSS Scorecard: 10, 10, 9.9, 9.6, 7.5 — The Patch You Can't Skip This Week
opportunities.why_now: Cisco just dropped nine Crosswork/Secure Workload flaws with five perfect 10.0 scores, corroborated across The Register and The Hacker News.
opportunities.angle: Rapid patch-cadence breakdown: rank the five CVEs by exploitability, give a 'patch by EOD' checklist, and mock the absurdity of five 10-scores in one advisory.

opportunities.title: North Korea Just Poisoned Your Rust Toolchain — Here's What Was Stolen
opportunities.why_now: SecurityWeek confirmed the Rust crates supply-chain attack (first reported by The Register) is now attributed to North Korean actors, elevating it from 'incident' to 'nation-state campaign.'
opportunities.angle: Threat-actor deep dive: timeline of the crates.io compromise, IOCs devs should grep for, and why open-source registries remain the softest underbelly.

opportunities.title: CISA Says Patch TrueConf Now — But Should You Even Be Running Russia's Zoom?
opportunities.why_now: CISA issued an urgent KEV directive for TrueConf vulnerabilities under active exploitation, confirmed by both The Register and SecurityWeek within 24 hours.
opportunities.angle: Patch-now alert with a geopolitical twist — combine the technical fix with a 'why is this software on your network at all' risk-assessment angle.

opportunities.title: GitLab's Newest CVE Went From Disclosure to Active Exploitation in Days
opportunities.why_now: CVE-2026-19478 is already being exploited in the wild just days after disclosure, a textbook case of the shrinking patch window.
opportunities.angle: Patch-cadence math piece: chart the disclosure-to-exploit timeline and use it as a recurring 'the clock is the threat' data point for the digest.

opportunities.title: France's Tax Authority Breach: 600K Citizens, Including Private Messages, Now Exposed
opportunities.why_now: A fresh government breach with a concrete victim count and unusually sensitive data (private messages) makes this a clean, high-stakes breach-digest entry.
opportunities.angle: Classic inevitable-breach writeup: what was taken, what France is (or isn't) doing, and how this stacks up against other 2026 government breaches.
